hypothesis.statement: Small product teams experience enough costly late accessibility rework to pay for earlier automated review.

assumptions.statement: Late rework costs exceed an early review subscription
Teams can adopt review before release

evidence.claim: A five-person team spent two sprints correcting late accessibility defects.
One team reported rare accessibility rework and no budget for another tool.
